snippet.title: Age of Reforging: The Freelands - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Age of Reforging: The Freelands trailer for this sandbox adventure CRPG. The Age of Reforging: The Freelands trailer gives a deep dive into what you can expect, including the story, features you can find, environments you'll explore, and more. Age of Reforging: The Freelands version 1.0 will be available on PC on April 28, 2025.

In Age of Reforging: The Freelands, you'll be a reforger in freelands chosen by the Goddess to embark on a medieval adventure tour at your own pace, gathering teammates, seeking survival, and craft your unique legend.
